subject_description: a small squat chibi warrior in a white rabbit-eared hood with a black face and glowing orange eyes, holding a big orange saw-blade cleaver low in front
initial_pose: standing ready, crouched low, cleaver held low across the body
description: fast short-legged run cycle to the right, quick little strides, body leaning forward, the big cleaver held low and steady, the long hood ears and orange scarf bouncing behind. Stays in the same place on the canvas (running in place, the background scrolls), a seamless loop. Side view facing right in every frame, same size. No dust, no effects.
